label: Bachelor thesis
title: Vulnerable-dependency remediation viability in OSS ecosystems
summary: I’m investigating whether upstream maintenance history adds useful prospective signal about how quickly vulnerable dependencies are remediated, beyond vulnerability, remediation and consumer-project context.
hypothesisTitle: DOES UPSTREAM MAINTENANCE ADD INCREMENTAL VALUE?
methodologyHint: Current work compares nested evidence sets and keeps the final outcome and model open until feasibility and out-of-time validation support them.
